## Overview

The final week brings everything together in Europe and the Netherlands. It covers the **EU AI Act**, its risk-based approach, and what the Act does not cover. It looks at who makes and enforces the rules (the European Parliament and the **EU AI Office**) and at the **GPAI Code of Practice**. Then it turns to the Dutch organisations that oversee AI models, and ends by discussing where the EU's strengths lie, as a starting point for the [final essay](essay.qmd).

## Learning objectives

By the end of this week, you can:

- Explain the risk-based approach of the EU AI Act
- Explain what the EU AI Act does not cover
- Describe how the EU AI Office is structured and what the GPAI Code of Practice asks of model providers
- Name the Dutch organisations responsible for overseeing AI models
- Identify open research questions on EU AI law
